statement.zh-TW: {{raw:2001}} 年修正前的公司法，曾把資產重估增值與處分固定資產收益列為資本公積的來源；在現行 IFRS 下，這兩項都不列入資本公積。
statement.en: Before its {{raw:2001}} amendment, the Company Act listed revaluation increments and gains on disposal of property, plant and equipment as sources of capital surplus; under current IFRS neither goes to capital surplus.

feedbackTrue.zh-TW: 答對了。現行 IFRS 下，處分不動產、廠房及設備的利益列入當期損益；重估增值經其他綜合損益，累計在股東權益的其他權益項下。課程的清單就是這種舊制分類，保留下來是因為它是課堂的脈絡；判斷現行做法時以準則與公司法為準。
feedbackTrue.en: Correct. Under current IFRS a gain on disposal of property, plant and equipment goes to profit or loss, and a revaluation increment goes through other comprehensive income to other equity. The course list follows this older classification and is kept because it is the classroom context; for current practice, the standards and the Company Act govern.

feedbackFalse.zh-TW: 你可能以為這兩項現在仍列資本公積。現行準則把處分利益放在損益，重估增值放在其他權益。
feedbackFalse.en: You may have assumed these two items still go to capital surplus. Current standards put the disposal gain in profit or loss and the revaluation increment in other equity.

explanation.zh-TW: 資本公積的核心是股東投入超過面額的部分。其他來源要逐一對照現行準則；台灣的公開發行公司依規定對不動產、廠房及設備採成本模式，實務上也很少再出現新的重估增值（現行規定，查證於 {{raw:2026-10-24}}）。本章只練習觀念，不出計算題。
explanation.en: The core of capital surplus is shareholder contributions above par. Other sources have to be checked one by one against current standards; Taiwanese public companies are required to use the cost model for property, plant and equipment, so new revaluation increments rarely arise in practice (current rules, checked on {{raw:2026-10-24}}). This chapter practises concepts only and sets no calculation questions.
